column2: Hendrik has two timed attacks and two once-per-battle reactive skills
all Hendrik numbers are finite editable configuration records
Crippling Blow hits only surrounding enemies for 140 percent
Crippling Blow stun grows in lost-health steps with a configured cap
Shield Bash damages one target, knocks it back and stuns without touching remote foes
Shield Bash respects control immunity for both stun and push
fatal backline hit triggers Sacrificial Shield before death and guardian takes damage
nonfatal or front-row damage never spends the rescue
shield absorption is considered before deciding whether an incoming hit is fatal
rescue redirects later nonfatal hits then expires and cannot activate a second time
a dead or confined guardian cannot rescue, and never revives a dead ally
redirect damage applies guardian mitigation and shield without double offensive crit or variance
two Hendriks cannot bounce redirected damage in a rescue recursion
Standfast only activates below forty percent after a nonlethal hit, once per battle
Standfast heals six percent max HP each second, not once per render or partial tick
Standfast stops at ninety percent with no extra heal and reduction disappears
Standfast stops at ten seconds even if incoming damage prevents reaching ninety percent
death or control cancels Standfast healing without rearming its once-per-battle use
no tick means no healing, guard countdown or defensive timer advance
reactive skills are never offered as cooldown attacks or resolved manually
